A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a low-precision neural network inference architecture with cyclic activations, which can be implemented in hardware or in software, and which achieves comparable performance and energy-efficiency to state-of-the-art low-precision inference methods.
we show that it is feasible to perform neural network inference using only 8-bit arithmetic, which is the minimum precision needed to avoid overflow for all the operations.
we propose WrapNet as a new neural network architecture, which is resilient to low-precision (i.e., 8-bit) additions and can be implemented on low-cost embedded devices.
